name: HYDRA-UMC-OS
build: Functional read-only CM5 platform agent, validated configuration, systemd unit and host-side tests.
notes: A reproducible HYDRA-UMC product layer on Raspberry Pi OS, not a new Linux distribution. Provides a read-only agent, validated configuration, profiles, diagnostics, Server staging and an optional loopback Voice UI gateway. The preflight is proven idempotent and side-effect-free by a real test (two runs, byte-identical output, zero files touched), and a real, host-independent backup/rollback mechanism (provisioning/rollback.py) protects the one system file install_local_agent.sh unconditionally overwrites. CM5 validation and production image assembly remain release gates.
